description: Single-axis motor controller with homing support. Drives a motor to a target position using encoder pulse counting or time-based step control.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: Target position in encoder counts. Movement starts automatically after homing.

inputs.name: Encoder
inputs.description: Raw encoder pulse input. Each rising edge counts one step in the current motor direction.

inputs.name: Home
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge starts the homing sequence, moving the motor in the configured direction until the home switch activates.

inputs.name: Home switch
inputs.description: Active (true) when the axis is at the home/reference position. Used during homing to detect arrival at the reference point.

inputs.name: Stop
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge stops all movement and cancels homing. Dominant input. Position and homed status are preserved.

inputs.name: Home before move
inputs.description: When active, the motor automatically homes before moving to each new target. If the home switch is already active, movement starts immediately from position zero. Otherwise, the motor homes first and then proceeds to the target.

inputs.name: Frequency
inputs.description: Encoder pulse frequency in Hz. Used in Frequency control mode. The block calculates pulse count from frequency and elapsed time between inputs, switching to time-based estimation for the final approach.

outputs.name: Forward
outputs.description: Active when the motor should drive in the positive direction.

outputs.name: Reverse
outputs.description: Active when the motor should drive in the negative direction.

outputs.name: At target
outputs.description: True when the current position is within the configured tolerance of the target.

outputs.name: Homed
outputs.description: True after a successful homing sequence has completed.

outputs.name: Moving
outputs.description: True when the motor is actively driving in either direction.

outputs.name: Position %
outputs.description: Current position as a percentage (0-100) of the configured full travel length.

outputs.name: RPM
outputs.description: Current motor speed in revolutions per minute.

config.name: Home direction
config.description: Motor direction during the homing sequence.

config.name: Position tolerance
config.description: Maximum acceptable distance from the target position to be considered at target. 0 means exact match.

config.name: Control mode
config.description: Encoder mode uses external encoder pulses to track position. Time-based mode uses internally timed steps. Frequency mode tracks position from periodic frequency (Hz) inputs, with automatic time-based finish for the final approach.

config.name: Pulse time forward
config.description: Duration of one position step when moving forward. Used in Time-based and Frequency modes. In Frequency mode serves as initial estimate before real data arrives.

config.name: Pulse time reverse
config.description: Duration of one position step when moving in reverse. Used in Time-based and Frequency modes. In Frequency mode serves as initial estimate before real data arrives.

config.name: Motor lock duration
config.description: Pause duration between direction changes to protect the motor. The motor stops for this period before starting in the opposite direction. Set to 0 to disable.

config.name: Full travel steps
config.description: Number of steps that represent 100% of the axis travel. When set to 0, the position percentage output is disabled.

config.name: Steps per revolution
config.description: Number of encoder/frequency pulses per one full shaft revolution. Set to 0 to disable RPM output.

state.name: Previous encoder state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the encoder input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous home state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the home input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous stop state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the stop input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Is homing
state.description: True while the homing sequence is in progress.

state.name: Pending target
state.description: Stores the target position to move to after homing completes when home-before-move is active.

state.name: Move after home
state.description: True when the motor should automatically move to the pending target after homing completes.

state.name: Move start time
state.description: System uptime when the current time-based movement started. Used to compute elapsed time for position tracking.

state.name: Move start position
state.description: Position when the current time-based movement started. Used with elapsed time to compute the current position.

state.name: Move target
state.description: Target position for the current time-based movement.

state.name: Was forward
state.description: True if the last motor movement was in the forward direction. Used for motor lock delay calculation.

state.name: Last stop time
state.description: System uptime when the motor last stopped. Used for motor lock delay calculation.

state.name: Lock target
state.description: Target position stored while waiting for the motor lock delay to complete.

state.name: Lock position
state.description: Current position stored while waiting for the motor lock delay to complete.

state.name: Last frequency input time
state.description: System uptime when the last frequency input was received or movement started.

state.name: Average pulse time
state.description: Running average of pulse duration in milliseconds, calculated from frequency inputs during travel.

state.name: Frequency sample count
state.description: Number of frequency input samples received during the current movement.

state.name: Frequency finishing
state.description: True when the block has switched to time-based estimation for the final approach in Frequency mode.

state.name: Fractional pulses
state.description: Accumulated fractional pulse remainder from frequency-to-pulse calculations.

state.name: Frequency travel start time
state.description: System uptime when the current frequency-mode travel started.

state.name: Frequency travel steps
state.description: Total steps to travel in the current frequency-mode movement.

state.name: Frequency input sum
state.description: Sum of all frequency input values received during the current travel.

state.name: First pulse time
state.description: Pulse time from the first frequency input of the current travel.

state.name: Max frequency gap
state.description: Maximum elapsed time between consecutive frequency inputs during the current travel.

state.name: Last encoder pulse time
state.description: System uptime of the last encoder rising edge. Used to calculate inter-pulse timing for RPM.
